user_reported_bug: the About page is not allowing me to scroll
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Verified the exact /about scroll failure and requested regressions on /features, /, and /pricing in a 1920x1080 Chromium/Xvfb desktop run. /about now scrolls via mouse wheel (0->900), trackpad-like wheel (0->900), keyboard ArrowDown (0->480), PageDown/Space (0->945), scrollbar track click (0->945), native scrollbar drag (0->6551), and can reach bottom/back (8694 max). /features, /, and /pricing each have one document-level vertical scrollbar and scroll normally.
critical_code_review_comments: Inspected /app/frontend/src/index.css and confirmed body no longer sets overflow-y: clip/hidden/scroll/auto; runtime computed styles show html overflow-y:auto, body/root overflow-y:visible, and only the html document scroller is scrollable on the tested public pages.

Read /app/frontend/src/pages/About.jsx; no page-level scroll interception or nested overflow container was found. /app/memory/test_credentials.md was not present, but credentials are not required for these public routes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focused scroll verification only. Mandatory skill lookup was performed first and returned no relevant testing skill. Test command used for final passing evidence: Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1920x1080x24 ... DISPLAY=:99 python /app/tests/scroll_bug_verification_iter82.py --headed. Headed/Xvfb was required because headless Chromium uses overlay scrollbars and cannot reliably hit-test native scrollbar drag/click.
rca_of_the_issue: The fixed CSS restores default vertical page scrolling by keeping overflow-x hidden only on html and leaving body/root overflow-y visible. Regression evidence: /features has a single scroll container (html only), viewport scrollbar width 15px in headed run, and no body/root nested vertical scrollbars. No mocked APIs were used.
